verdict.rationale: The only related controls in the evidence are an opt-out of all data retention, which applies only to self-hosted Enterprise and covers code-related data like learnings and review context, plus a separately controllable model-output-logging setting; CodeRabbit also states it never trains on customer code. None of these is a documented opt-out of product telemetry or usage tracking, and the dashboard shows usage metrics are collected. missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out for the cloud service, CLI and IDE extension; documentation of what usage data is collected; independent corroboration.
